name: quantum-gear-extra
description: Quantum Gear, Additional Version: React + Tailwind front end, Node.js + Express API, same MySQL database

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
